{"id":1941961856,"question_id":4192,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1772975252,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"82 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1941961856/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost to Partition a Binary String","memory":"125.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    vector<ll>pref;\n\n    ll minfxn(string &s , int &ec , int &fc , int start , int end)\n    {\n        ll size = end - start + 1;\n        ll bulkcost = 0;\n        ll splitcost = 0;\n\n        int ones = pref[end + 1] - pref[start];\n        bulkcost += (ones == 0) ? fc : (1LL * size * ones * ec);\n\n        if(size % 2 == 1) return bulkcost;\n\n        ll mid = (start + end) / 2;\n\n        splitcost += (minfxn(s , ec , fc , start , mid) + minfxn(s , ec , fc , mid + 1 , end));\n\n        return min(bulkcost , splitcost);\n    }\n\n    long long minCost(string s, int encCost, int flatCost) {\n        int n = s.size();\n\n        pref.resize(n+1);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            pref[i+1] = pref[i] + (s[i] == '1');\n        }\n        // for(auto it : pref) cout<<it<<\" \";\n\n        return minfxn(s , encCost , flatCost , 0 , n-1);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-partition-a-binary-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1811}
